hero.badge: The New Era of Dental Marketing
hero.subtitle: The complete platform for dental clinics. Smart scheduling, digital records, WhatsApp, CRM with Meta Ads, and a financial hub — all integrated.

features.title: Everything your clinic needs
features.subtitle: One complete platform, no need to hire separate systems for each function.

agenda.title: Smart scheduling that works for you
agenda.description: See every provider on a single screen, move appointments with drag-and-drop, and let patients book online 24 hours a day — no phone calls needed.
agenda.item2: Online booking through the patient portal
agenda.item3: Multiple providers and locations on the same screen
agenda.item4: Digital check-in and virtual waiting room

whatsapp.title: Centralized communication on WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Connect your office number to the platform and manage every patient conversation in a centralized inbox. Automatic reminders reduce no-shows without effort from your team.
whatsapp.item1: Automatic reminders 48h, 24h and 2h before the appointment
whatsapp.item3: Human inbox with a kanban of conversations
whatsapp.item5: Quick replies and tags to organize conversations
whatsapp.item6: Response time SLA visible to the team

prontuario.title: Complete, multi-specialty electronic records
prontuario.description: Log progress notes, prescriptions and exams in a visual clinical timeline. Supports multiple specialties — dentistry, nutrition, general medicine — all in one place.
prontuario.item2: Digital progress notes, prescriptions and orders
prontuario.item3: Upload and view exams and documents
prontuario.item4: Digital odontogram with procedures by tooth surface

financeiro.title: Payment hub with 3 integrated gateways
financeiro.description: Accept payments via PIX, bank slip, credit card, or financing — all within the platform. Automatic webhooks update the appointment status as soon as payment is confirmed.
financeiro.item1: Asaas: instant PIX, bank slip and card
financeiro.item3: Dr. Cash: card-free financing in up to 24 installments
financeiro.item4: Integrated checkout modal during the visit

crm.title: CRM + integration with Meta and Google Ads
crm.description: Manage your lead pipeline with a follow-up kanban and see in real time where your patients came from — Facebook, Instagram, or Google. Make marketing decisions backed by real data.
crm.item5: ROAS, CPL and conversion rate dashboard
crm.item6: Automatic lead capture from ad forms

portal.title: Patient Portal
portal.desc: Online booking, history and profile — all accessible from a phone.

dicom.title: DICOM & Imaging
dicom.desc: Radiograph and imaging exam viewer directly in the patient record.

reports.title: Reports
reports.desc: Occupancy, revenue and performance analytics with export.

lgpd.title: LGPD & Security
lgpd.desc: Encrypted data, per-tenant RLS and full LGPD compliance.

solutions.title: Built for your specialty
solutions.subtitle: The same platform, configured for every type of clinic. No extra modules, no added cost.

medicoAutonomo.title: Independent Physician
medicoAutonomo.desc: A solo practice with online scheduling, records and automatic WhatsApp. Run your practice without a receptionist, 24 hours a day.

clinicaMedica.title: Medical Clinic
clinicaMedica.desc: Multiple providers, patient CRM and an integrated financial hub, all in one platform.

odontologia.title: Dentistry
odontologia.desc: Digital odontogram, treatment estimates, DICOM viewer and per-patient treatment tracking.

nutricao.title: Nutrition and Wellness
nutricao.desc: Anthropometric assessment, body composition and meal plans integrated into the patient record.

psicologia.title: Psychology and Mental Health
psicologia.desc: Tailored records, digital prescriptions and recurring scheduling for weekly therapy sessions.

redes.title: Networks and Franchises
redes.desc: Master Dashboard with a centralized view of every location, consolidated revenue and a dedicated API.
